author: Mehrp
body: I decided to appeal this, not because I feel that this warn was unjust-quite the contrary. I decided to appeal because I regret doing what I did. I was on ts w/ the moderator who warned me and we were having fun and some jokes but then I took it too far and I typed in /warn awesomerp rule 3 sec .b. This is, of course, ironic, and although it was quite funny it was still against  the rules. I now appreciate how much rules <u>do</u> need to be followed, regardless or how funny it is. You could say that my report worked, I ended up getting myself a warn. however, I am very sorry for breaking the rules and it will not (and I has not) happened again. Although it didn't, abusing the report command like that could have caused disruption to a fairly big extent, I did not intend for it do to so but it still could have-and for this I want apologise. Because I have changed so much and would now no longer do this, I feel that I should be appealed (also because I apologise for this).

title: An appeal for a warn  (Inf.608666)

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I appreciate the fact that you regret your actions. However, you did break the rules, and therefore it's valid. After all it's only a warm, and a valid warn. There is no reason for this to be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
